name: ACE Mentor Program of Greater New York
org: ACE Mentor Program of Greater NY
city: Teams in Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Long Island, White Plains and Riverdale (and remote)
what_you_do: Join a free after-school team of 20 to 30 students and 12 to 15 pros in architecture, engineering and construction. You learn design software and present a team project at a year-end showcase.
who_can_apply: Any high school student in grades 9 to 12. No experience is needed. No grades, essays or recommendation letters are needed. A parent consent form is needed.
pay_detail: Free. No pay is mentioned. Scholarship and internship chances are listed as benefits.
duration: Late October through May (about 2 hours after school per meeting). Some teams start in January.
deadline_text: Team selection emails start in September. The page gives no registration dates and no closing date, and does not say whether registration is open now.
how_to_apply: Register on the ACE GNY website. Use the yellow button on the students page. Get a parent to sign a consent form. Pick a team from the map you get by email. Then wait for a confirmation email.
notes: Teams meet at host firms or universities. The page also links to a Summer Internship Program for alumni, which this card does not cover.
